units.source_text: 但是根据你之前说的，我以为我们都是一样的呢。

en.t: But from what you said before, I thought we were all the same.

units.source_text: 你认为少爷爱上女仆，千金小姐爱上司机，是因为什么呢？

en.t: Why do you think young masters fall in love with maids, and young ladies with chauffeurs?

units.source_text: 难道那不都是消灭恶性遗传吗？

en.t: Is that not all a way of eliminating harmful heredity?

units.source_text: 首先，和你之前谈到的为了一条铁路而互相残杀的义勇队相比，

en.t: To begin with, compared with the volunteer corps you mentioned before, who slaughter one another over a single railway,

units.source_text: 我觉得我们的义勇队要更加高尚呢！”

en.t: I think our volunteer corps is far nobler!"
